sources.snippet: SkillGate is a research codebase for training LLM agents to decide when to read, which skill to trust, and how to act when a library of textual skills (procedural instructions) is available in long-horizon coding/terminal tasks. sources.title: SkillGate: Training In-Policy Skill Selection in Long-Horizon Agents
sources.snippet: We propose SkillGate, which partitions one policy's token support into disjoint execution and selection credit channels, together with the mechanisms that make the partition exact in practice: rollout-time span attribution, a clean single-oracle utility with group centring, and length-invariant reweighting.
